 Battery exit playoffs in Eastern Conference Final defeat against Louisville 
 By Charleston Battery Published : Nov. 14, 2026 at 10:11 PM EST Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google CHARLESTON, S.C. (November 14, 2026) – The Charleston Battery fell 0-2 to Louisville City FC in the Eastern Conference Final of the USL Championship Playoffs in front of a sold-out crowd at Patriots Point on Saturday. Charleston created ample chances throughout the night but were unable to fully break down the Louisville defense. A goal off an error in the first half and another one in the second half for the visitors proved to make the difference. The defeat ends Charleston’s season, as the team reached the Eastern Conference Final three times in the last four years. 
 Charleston and Louisville kicked off what was essentially a carbon copy of the 2023 Eastern Conference Final, also played at Patriots Point, which the Battery won by a score of 2-1.
 Additionally, it was a milestone night for Graham Smith, who made his 100th career appearance for the Battery. Smith, who joined Charleston in 2024, became the 28th player in club history to cross the century mark for the Black and Yellow. 
 The Battery started the night on the front foot and recorded two early shots on target. Miguel Berry and Jeremy Kelly had looks inside the box in the 2nd and 5th minutes, respectively, but both attempts were saved by goalkeeper Ryan Schewe.
 Louisville managed to open the scoring in the 9th minute via Ray Serrano to take a 0-1 lead. 
 Charleston were quick to fight back in search of an equalizer. Kelly and Berry maintained the pressure up top and Berry was on target again in the 27th minute, however, his header was saved. 
 The visitors held onto the 0-1 lead into halftime despite the Battery outshooting Louisville by a margin of nine to two, and holding upwards of 71% possession. 
 Play resumed in the second half with 45 minutes left for Charleston to turn the game around in their favor. 
 Charleston appeared to have leveled the score in the 58th minute when Kirill Pakhomov’s cross into the box ended up in the back of the net, but the goal was chalked off for an apparent foul in the box. Minutes later, Houssou Landry was brought down inside the box, though no foul was called despite appeals from Battery players. 
 Louisville added a second goal in the 68th minute to go up 0-2 via Manny Perez. 
 Laurent Kissiedou, shortly after entering the match, nearly pulled one back with a shot off the rebound from the edge of the box in the 81st minute, which was saved. 
 Charleston had a flurry of shots inside the six-yard box in the 84th minute, but the Louisville defense managed to stop all the attempts and keep the Battery off the board. Kissiedou was again on target in the 92nd minute, however, his strike was saved as the match entered the final moments. 
 Unlike the heroics of the previous two rounds, the Battery were unable to overcome the 0-2 deficit, and Louisville held on to win the Eastern Conference Final. 
 The defeat marked the end of the Battery’s 2026 season as the Lowcountry club reached the Eastern Conference Final for the third time in the last four years.
